_comment: HUD layout for Lucas's ultrawide, measured from test/fixtures/screen/ultrawide_3440x1440_full.png (2026-07-22). Every region is an offset from an ANCHOR — a unique piece of UI chrome located at runtime — so the panels can move without a manual wizard. Offsets and sizes are pixels; `ink` is the text brightness floor a region needs (see Vision.Glyphs).
name: ultrawide_3440x1440

battle_header.note: The only anchor that survives live: the right dock is OPAQUE, so its pixels do not change with the map behind it. The bottom bar and the left HUD are semi-transparent — templates cut from them matched the fixture and matched NOTHING once Lucas walked onto different ground.

battle_list.note: Tall enough for all six rows INCLUDING the sixth's HP bar (42 + 5*46 + 30).

minimap_coord.note: Sized for the LONGEST coordinate seen, not the first one measured — the original rect fit '(337, 46107, 4)' and cut the ')' off '(2782, 30571, 5)'.

hud_bottom.note: FIXED, not anchored: this panel is docked to a screen edge at this resolution AND is semi-transparent, so it can be neither anchored by pixels nor derived from the dock. Verified against two captures taken hours apart on different maps: every rect below still read its value.

level.note: The CHARACTER's level. It can go DOWN — dying in PXG costs experience — so never gate a reading on 'levels only increase'.

slot_f1.note: Sized for the FIELD, not for the first value seen: the counts are right-aligned in a 51px-pitch box, so a rect cut to fit '7' silently truncated '402' to '2'. The vertical band is tight to the digits (measured y 1412..1423) because the item sprite above them has grey highlights that survive the ink floor and segment as extra glyphs.

team_column.note: FIXED, not anchored: this panel is docked to a screen edge at this resolution AND is semi-transparent, so it can be neither anchored by pixels nor derived from the dock. Verified against two captures taken hours apart on different maps: every rect below still read its value.

team_bar_first.note: Width is the FULL-FILL extent (measured on both captures), so a healthy member reads 100% instead of 98%.

mini_game.note: FIXED, not anchored: the fishing mini-game bar is drawn inside the game viewport near its right edge, not in a dock panel. Proof: this rect is from Lucas's 2-moni-8skill profile, measured when the battle panel sat at y=287; he later enlarged the minimap and pushed that panel to y=460, and the strip stayed correct. Anchoring it to the battle header would have dragged it 173px down.

team_icon_first.note: The first C+N row's circular portrait (measured: discs at x 18..94, 56px tall, repeating every 67px). Its centre is the rect's centre and its radius half the height.

battle_rows.note: Measured on the real captures: rows repeat every 46px (his battle_row_height setting says 52, tuned for a panel position that no longer exists). Offsets are relative to the battle_list region's own origin, because that is the frame the feed captures.
